note: The original spells the species name grandifons (should be grandifrons); only the dealate female adult is described.

sections.label: Diagnostic characters
sections.text: Fontanelle very large and conspicuous—a transparent elongate-oval depression, 0.25 mm long and 0.20 mm wide; compared with A. howardi the fontanelle is conspicuous, the pronotum larger, and the posterior emargination of the meso- and metanotum wider and rounder.

sections.label: Alate
sections.text: Dealate female: head dark chestnut brown, wider than long (from posterior margin to base of postclypeus), covered with dense long and short hairs. Fontanelle a very conspicuous, transparent elongate-oval depression, slightly oblique, 0.25 mm long and 0.20 mm wide. Compound eyes black, nearly circular, large and projecting, adjacent to the lateral margins of the head. Ocelli transparent, nearly oval, upper margin projecting, separated from the compound eyes by their short diameter. Postclypeus pale chestnut, bilobed, projecting, slightly more than twice as wide as long, covered with long hairs. Mandibles yellow, chestnut at the apex, elongate. Antennae yellowish brown, 15-segmented, covered with long hairs; segment 3 shorter than segments 2 and 4, narrow, ring-like; segment 4 shorter than segment 2; gradually longer and wider toward the apex; apical segment slender, nearly oval. Pronotum slightly paler than the head, saddle-shaped, less than twice as wide as long, sides angular but broadly and gently receding to the posterior margin, covered with dense long and short hairs. Meso- and metanotum deeply, widely and roundly emarginate. Legs yellow, brownish dorsally, covered with long hairs. Abdominal tergites dark chestnut brown, densely hairy; cerci indistinct. Measurements: dealate body length 9.00 mm; head length (to the apex of the labrum) 1.60 mm; left mandible length 0.80 mm; pronotum length 0.70 mm, width 1.20 mm; hind tibia length 1.60 mm; compound eye long diameter 0.85 mm; head width (between the eyes) 1.40 mm.

sections.label: Other
sections.text: Type locality Rosario, Bolivia; the description is based on a single dealate female collected in a termite nest in November 1921 (month 11) by W. M. Mann, taken together with A. pacificus. Holotype dealate female, USNM Cat. No. 27665.
